name: Holecraft
description: Open-source, offline, browser-based 3D modelling for makers. Build parts from shapes, cut holes, add fasteners, hollow and tilt models for resin printing, place support points, and export STL or 3MF, with no account and nothing sent to the internet. Designs are saved on your server. It can send a model straight to Trident, the self-hosted slicer, and its Resin tools (hollow, drain holes, supports) use Trident 0.7.0 or later. There is no login: keep it on a trusted network.

paths.name: Data
